A receipt is a timestamped, hashed, sealed proof that a claim touched an independent system and survived. Not a badge. Not a score. A fossil of contact between intent and outcome. We build the tools that create, store, and verify these receipts: GetReceipts — the entry point where anyone can start proving their claims against reality. The magic words: ''reality speaks in receipts.'' Box7 — an individual navigation cockpit that uses receipts to help you see where you actually are, not where you think you are. Box9 — a team coordination layer where shared receipts become the operating system for collective decision-making. LAKIN is individual-first by design. We believe sovereignty scales up, not down. Every tool starts with one person and their relationship to evidence, then extends to teams who choose to share proof rather than promises.

LiveKit’s capabilities also extend to real-time data exchange, encryption, and adaptive streaming features that support secure and responsive applications. The company works with developers to integrate its communication layer into solutions such as collaborative tools, live streaming, customer support interfaces, and AI voice agents that interact through audio and video in real time.
